source.name: LIV Golf: Greyson Clothiers named Official Apparel Sponsor of all-Aussie LIV Golf team Ripper GC
source.quote: Ripper GC, the all-Australian team in the LIV Golf League, today announced a new partnership with Greyson Clothiers
source.note: Official team announcement; Greyson is the team's 'official apparel sponsor'. The page shows only 'NEWS · 19 MONTHS AGO' (opened 2026-10-03); the partnership began with the 2025 season. The Greyson logo still appears in the team page's partner rail (2026-10-03).

source.name: AirAsia Newsroom: AirAsia Partners With Reigning LIV Golf Champion Ripper GC
source.quote: AirAsia recently signed a new partnership with Ripper GC, one of the 13 teams in the LIV Golf League.
source.note: AirAsia's own announcement; under the deal Ripper GC players wear caps with the AirAsia logo at LIV Golf events. The AirAsia logo still appears in the team page's partner rail (2026-10-03).

source.name: LIV Golf: Hahn, Ripper GC announce partnership
source.quote: announcing a brand new partnership with Ripper GC, becoming an official sponsor of one of golf’s most electric teams
source.note: Official partnership announcement ('Hahn is swinging big in 2026'). The page shows only 'NEWS · 8 MONTHS AGO' (opened 2026-10-03); Mediaweek dates the announcement 3 February 2026.

source.name: LIV Golf: Partners
source.quote: New Era is a supplier partner and the Official Cap of LIV Golf and it’s 13 teams.
source.note: New Era is the league-wide Official Cap; its logo appears in the partner rail of every LIV team page, including Ripper GC's (checked 2026-10-03). League deal recorded in data/deals/liv-new-era.json.

summary: Team partners 2026: Greyson Clothiers (official apparel), AirAsia (players wear AirAsia-logo caps), Hahn (official sponsor since February 2026), New Era (LIV Golf's league-wide Official Cap, shown on the team page). Captain Cameron Smith.
